projects.name: Multi-Store E-commerce Platform
projects.summary: A multi-store e-commerce platform where one super admin runs many storefronts, each with its own products, orders, staff, theme and payment settings.
description: One super admin manages many online stores from a single platform. Every store has its own products, orders, staff, theme, delivery pricing and payment settings.

Customers can browse stores, search and filter products, use a basket, check out and track their orders. Payment is cash on delivery or a built-in demo online gateway, and digital products get time-limited download links.

Store teams have roles (owner, manager, inventory, support, content) plus custom roles. Orders are managed on a drag-and-drop board, with analytics and an audit log. Security includes two-step verification with an authenticator app, recovery codes and sign-in rate limits.
The admin area is at /admin on the live demo.

projects.name: GUTECH Learning Management Portal
projects.summary: A full-stack learning portal for GUTECH students and faculty with courses, assignments, quizzes, grading, announcements and chat.
description: A learning management portal for GUTECH students and faculty. Admins manage users and courses, teachers create assignments and quizzes and grade work with feedback, and students submit work and see their marks.
Other features include announcements, classroom chat, complaint submission with admin responses, and private course resources with file type and size checks.

Access is role-based: the API enforces roles and course membership, and row-level security in the database protects records. Sign-in uses email and password with password recovery and a forced password change on first login.

projects.name: MindAnchor
projects.summary: A privacy-first digital-wellbeing web app for students, built as a team project, to reduce app overuse and support focus, rest and stress relief.
description: MindAnchor is a privacy-first wellbeing app for students, built as a university team project where I contributed as a collaborator. It helps them cut down on digital app overuse and the mental strain that comes with it.

Accounts are nickname-only (or Guest) and all data stays in the browser, with no server, email or analytics. The app has five tabs: Today (mood check-in and weekly time saved), Focus & Tasks (a task slicer that breaks work into four 15-minute steps, plus focus sprints), Calm (breathing, 5-4-3-2-1 grounding and a music player), Guard (overnight lockout, time caps and a pause before scrolling) and Me & Privacy (data download or wipe).

A Quick Exit button and a Get Real Help button, with Pakistan helplines first, appear on every screen. It installs on a phone like an app (PWA), and the site also has a user guide, an evidence page backed by the team's own interviews and survey, and a project blog.
